title: verify_report.json (verify_report/v1)
description: The self-check gate written by verify_deck.py. Semantics, not just shape: a check's status is PASS (the named invariant was mechanically confirmed), FAIL (it was contradicted), SKIP (deliberately not run — a reason is required in 'detail'), or UNVERIFIED (it could not be decided). verdict is PASS **iff** FAIL == 0 AND UNVERIFIED == 0; SKIP alone does not fail the gate but must carry a recorded reason. warnings[] is a separate ADVISORY channel: it records observations that do not fail the gate, and consumers must never turn a warning into a FAIL. A green gate proves only the invariants it names - it does not certify the presentation's science or its quality.

case_id.description: Echoed from the case; null when the input case.json declares no case_id. The schema describes the artifact as produced (measured), not an idealised shape.

status.description: PASS = confirmed; FAIL = contradicted; SKIP = deliberately not run (reason required); UNVERIFIED = could not be decided

evidence.description: <path>:<line> or a JSON pointer into an artifact

advisory.description: true when the check reports advice only and cannot fail the gate

warnings.description: advisory channel; never affects verdict. Each entry names the check that observed something worth reporting without it being a defect.

artifacts.description: the artifacts the gate inspected: absolute path, sha256 and where the path came from (e.g. {"deck": "/…/deck.pptx", "deck_sha256": "…", "deck_path_source": "work-dir"})

coverage.description: what the gate actually saw (slides, bullets, figures/tables/numbers/claims in material)

scope.description: what this gate does and does not certify, per check

allOf.description: verdict must agree with the counts (documented constraint; enforced by the producer)
